precommitted_interpretation_checks: Q3 versus Q2 revenue rises 1625 USD million: net interest income +563 and noninterest income +1062. Neither line alone explains the entire increase.

At the selected income-statement level, revenue minus provision minus noninterest expense equals pretax income in both quarters. The Q3-Q2 pretax change is +1768 USD million, exactly +1625 - (-297) - 154.

Tax expense rises 415 USD million and preferred stock dividends rise 138 USD million. Net income rises 1353 USD million and common net income rises 1215 USD million. These are accounting bridges, not causal explanations of why the source lines changed.

Do not substitute fully taxable-equivalent (FTE), segment, year-to-date, prior-year or EPS figures for these current-quarter GAAP levels. Do not infer a trading or valuation recommendation from this packet.
